earned_statement: The committed FRE projection-provenance invariant reduces to a formal projection-congruence obstruction R4 together with an additional operational-relevance condition R5.

interpretation.R4: R4 says the public projection forgot a registered distinction.
interpretation.R5: R5 says that the forgotten distinction matters to FRE.
interpretation.combined: FRE projection-provenance requires both a distinction hidden by the public projection and receipt-backed evidence that the hidden distinction remains operationally relevant.

keeper_line: R4 says the projection forgot a distinction. R5 says the distinction still matters.

declarative_infrastructure.R2: explicit lossy projection pi: X -> Y

entailed_condition.R3: noninjectivity on the witnessed registered-state set

formal_obstruction.meaning: Public projection equality does not determine registered FRE congruence.
formal_obstruction.statement: exists x,x' in X such that pi(x)=pi(x') and not(x ~_FRE x')

operational_condition.meaning: The registered distinction forgotten by the public projection changes an FRE-relevant outcome.
operational_condition.statement: Provenance discarded by pi is operationally relevant to FRE.
